Build the 9x9 ritual platform: Polished Darkstone paths, Arcane Chiseled Polished Darkstone on the eight pedestal marks, a Chiseled cross around the center, and a Smithing Table on the center mark.
Use Mundabitur Dust on the Smithing Table to transform it into the Hephaestus Forge (Tier 1).
Place Darkstone Pedestals on the eight arcane marks - ritual ingredients go on these. Feed essences (Aureal bottles, blood, XP, souls) into the forge.
kubejs.ponder.hephaestus_forge_tier_2.te: Upgrade ritual to Tier 2: Edelwood Planks (main) + 4x Arcane Crystal + 4x Spawner Scrap on the pedestals.
Tier 2 expands the essence pool for costlier rituals.
kubejs.ponder.hephaestus_forge_tier_3.te: Upgrade ritual to Tier 3: Chiseled Polished Darkstone (main) + 4x Arcane Crystal + 4x Deorum Ingot on the pedestals.
Tier 3 expands the essence pool for costlier rituals.
kubejs.ponder.hephaestus_forge_tier_4.te: Upgrade ritual to Tier 4: Chiseled Polished Darkstone (main) + 4x Stellarite Piece + 4x Rune on the pedestals.
Tier 4 unlocks: Astral Metal ritual (fusion matrix + starmetal-iron, meteor ingots, fallen stars).
kubejs.ponder.hephaestus_forge_tier_5.te: Upgrade ritual to Tier 5: Stellarite Block (main) + 4x Sculk Catalyst + 2x Dark Nether Star + 2x Dragon Scale on the pedestals.
Tier 5 unlocks the Thaumic metal rituals: Mithrillium, Adaminite and Mithminite.
